```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs daily at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  regenerate-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Authenticate as octavia-bot
        id: octavia-auth
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: sts.github.airbyte.io
          scope: repo:airbytehq/airbyte
          policy: octavia-bot

      - name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec
        run: |
          node scripts/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Format spec with prettier
        run: |
          pnpm prettier --write "static/api-specs/sonar.json"
        working-directory: docs

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.octavia-auth.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: "ci: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          title: "ci: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          body: |
            This PR automatically regenerates the cached Sonar API spec in Docusaurus.
            
            - Fetches latest spec from `https://airbyte-sonar-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/openapi/latest/app.json`
            - Formats with prettier
            
            Requested by @ian-at-airbyte.
          branch: "auto/regenerate-sonar-api-spec"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            auto-merge
            autogenerated
            documentation
```
